title: Serve until mind and body agree
summary: Let truth grow visible in the way the body moves through the day. Let this stay near the next choice: carry this with you: let the Guru's truth reach your food, speech, and shelter.
takeaway: Let conduct answer before performance does.
lifeApplication: Before speaking about values again, ask what your treatment of people showed today and choose the cleaner act.

source.shortMeaning: Service to the True Guru cleans both mind and body together.
source.lifeApplication: When life feels split, choose the service that cleans both motive and behavior.
